description: UAA's token endpoint takes a form-urlencoded body (docs.cloudfoundry.org/api/uaa, "Password Grant"), which the converter only records as a trait this package's generator doesn't read: stamp the http trait. App environment variables commonly hold secrets, and the spec types them as plain values: keep what the API returns Redacted through distilled. The same goes for two other secrets the spec leaves plain: a buildpack lifecycle's `token`, beside the `password` it does mark, and what GetServiceInstanceCredentials returns, the secrets apps get through VCAP_SERVICES (v3-apidocs.cloudfoundry.org "Get credentials for a user-provided service instance"). That body is a bare JSON object, and a raw response root can't take the trait, so it is retargeted to a map whose values do: each key's value decodes to one Redacted value. Requests need nothing: `credentials` is untyped there and every Redacted in a request is unwrapped before it is sent. Nothing on the wire changes.
